thread:
jess: quick FYIwe're seeing token accounting blips for sub-100ms streams when the edge emits provisional then a backend handoff confirms. provisional + confirmed both show up in console totals.

ryan: ugh. any trace? :eyes: 

jess: pasted a minimal reproduction from staging:
```
2026-04-02T15:02:01Z START session=x123 chunk=0 tokens=1 provisional=true
2026-04-02T15:02:02Z ROUTER_HANDOFF session=x123 to=node-b provisional_emitted=true fingerprint=abc123
2026-04-02T15:02:02Z NODE_B_TOOLCALL session=x123 suffix tokens=4 provisional=true fingerprint=abc123
2026-04-02T15:02:02Z LEDGER_COMMIT session=x123 confirmed_tokens=5\n```

owen: so both router and node emitted provisional for same fingerprint. ledger commit then also counts confirmed. double visible until cleanup job catches up.

anita: how often is this happening?

jess: in our reconnect flood test it's ~2% of streams, but it creates a big spike in "provisional_tokens" metric and alerts on customers with many tiny streams.

ryan: two quick approaches: 1) debounce provisional emission at the router (delay N ms for tiny streams), or 2) include fingerprint in provisional event and reconcile in finalizer to avoid double-charging.

owen: debounce seems cheap but shifts visibility latency. finalizer reconcile is more accurate but adds complexity/state. either way we need to show overlap in console so support isn't flooded.

anita: product ask: can we show a small "overlap risk" indicator next to token counts and surface raw provisional vs net provisional?

jess: agree. proposal: emit provisional immediately with an extra field "overlap_fp" when route_handoff detected, then finalizer dedupes matching overlap_fp entries within 3s and subtracts provisional before snapshot. also add console badge: "Overlap risk: 1.9% (5m)".

ryan: implementation notes: finalizer will need to index provisional events by overlap_fp -> provisional_entry_id and allow atomic reversion if a matching confirmed arrives. consider edgecases where confirmed arrives first then provisional (race)  we should handle both orders.

owen: you'll also need retention of overlap_fp for the reconciliation window; that increases memory but 3s * rate is small. we should instrument memory cost.

billing-bot: Created INF-2301: overlap_fp reconciliation for provisional tokens (assignee: owen). https://redwood.internal/INF-2301

anita: timeline? we should avoid toggling customer-visible billing semantics overnight. maybe start with console-only (visualize) then enable dedupe as opt-in for a pilot org.

jess: good call. I'll add a dashboard panel and a feature flag before touching billing pipeline. also will add a short doc for support.

ryan: ping me when you have the prototype; I'll help with finalizer atomicity. also drop any replay traces to me or DM owen. :thumbsup:
